messages:
Maya: quick smoke thread — ran a few microbenchmarks for fused qkv-pack + bias/rope epilogue. results are noisy but show a p95 regression vs flash variants :thinking_face:
Vikram: can you paste the bench command you used? want to replicate locally
Maya: ran with: ```./bench_attn --model=gpt2-medium --kernels=fused_pack_epilogue --seq=1024 --batch=4 --iters=200 --profiling=cpu,gpu```
Cheng: raw numbers I pulled (median of 3 runs): fused_pack_epilogue p50=6.2ms p95=18.7ms tokens/s=11.4k, flash_attn_v2 p50=5.9ms p95=12.3ms tokens/s=13.0k. allocation spikes on host at iteration ~150
Sara: interesting — p95 delta is big. any sign of kernel fallback in logs? or pager activity from paged-kv?
Maya: saw some kernel chooser logs: ``KERNEL_ROUTE: select=fused_pack_epilogue score=0.87 fallback=flash_v2 condition=mem_pressure:false`` and occasional ``PAGE_FAULT: paged-kv miss latency=2.1ms`` entries
Vikram: that paged-kv miss suggests we may be thrashing L2/L3 because qkv packing increases working set. ephemeral KV pages get pulled in/out when epilogue runs heavier math. can you repro with KV disabled?
Maya: reran with --kv-mode=none: fused p95 improves to 13.0ms, tokens/s=12.6k. so KV interactions are significant
Cheng: profiling flame suggests epilogue CUDA kernels have >30% more SM divergence after bias+rope folding is applied. likely the fused epilogue is generating divergent control flow for certain seq len tails
Sara: hypothesis: routing heur selects kernel by median seq length in the batch. when we have long tail (1-2 requests at 1024) the batcher mixes short and long which worsens divergence. propose routing by 90th percentile or conservative bucketization
Vikram: +1. also try a quick experiment: force kernel via env `RFORCE_KERNEL=fused_pack_epilogue` vs `RFORCE_KERNEL=flash_v2` and run CI micros to get stable numbers. if fused wins with kv disabled we know it's cache related
perf-bot: CI job #8734 finished: fused_pack_epilogue (kv=on) median=6.4ms p95=18.9ms; flash_v2 (kv=on) median=5.8ms p95=12.1ms; fused_pack_epilogue (kv=off) median=6.0ms p95=13.2ms
Maya: ok action items: 1) Vikram to run kernel-forcing matrix across seq lengths and kv modes (due EOD) 2) Cheng to capture per-thread divergence counters + SM occupancy for epilogue (due tomorrow) 3) Sara to adjust batcher heuristic to consider p90 seq length and run smoke (PR draft)
Vikram: I'll also add a temporary backoff: if paged-kv misses > 5% in last 100 requests, route away from fused epilogue. quick stopgap until we root cause
Sara: I'll open a small PR with the p90 change and config flag `router.seq_percentile=90` so we can toggle in staging
Maya: thanks team — leaning toward two followups: kernel microbench sweep + batcher routing change. we'll reconvene after results. :thumbsup:
